issues: Only the 2025-26 Program of Studies is published (home page heading 'Program of Studies 2025-2026'), although the 2026-27 year is underway; no 2026-27 version found on the school site or via search. Structure: Google Site with 8 subject pages (English, Fine Arts, Global Citizenship [social studies + world languages], Math, Professional Pursuits/Flexible Pathways/Driver's Ed/JROTC, PE & Health, Science, NCCC link) and ~160 course subpages, each embedding a separate Google Doc with grade levels, length, prerequisites and description (sampled Precalculus doc: public, exportable). Not crawled - only the home page HTML is saved (it contains add/drop policy, graduation requirements: 25 credits incl. English 4, Social Studies 3, Science 3, Math 3, PE 1.5, Health .5, Fine Arts 1, Electives 9, and grading). Phase 2 would need to walk the subject pages and export each course doc. One science course is labeled 'SPRING SEM. 2025/FALL SEM. 2026', so some content was edited after 2025-26 began.
